description: There's a vulnerability in the system (Hint: related to SUID). Find it and fix it.
set all files in ~/videos to be 660, and all directories(include ~/videos) to be 750

init.code: cd ~ && mkdir videos && cd videos && mkdir old && mkdir new && touch vid1 && touch vid2 && touch new/a && touch new/b && touch old/c

check.code: (find ~/videos -type f ! -perm 660 -ls && find ~/videos -type d ! -perm 750 -ls) | if [ "$(cat -)" = "" ]; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi

example.code: find ~/videos -type f -exec chmod 660 {} + && find ~/videos -type d -exec chmod 750 {} +
